The plate is a square side plate, roughly 24 cm across. It holds scrambled egg whites and roasted sweet potato cubes.

**Egg whites:** The pile covers about 14 × 11 cm and is roughly 3 cm high. It is fluffy and loosely packed, so I estimate about 170 g. Its white, translucent look points to egg white rather than cheese, so I use 55 kcal/100 g.

**Sweet potato:** The cubes cover about 8 × 7 cm and are 2 cm high, which comes to roughly 110 g. They look roasted with a little oil, so I use 130 kcal/100 g.
